summary.text: Mandie Landry is a Democrat member of the Louisiana House of Representatives representing District 91, which the legislature's member page lists as covering Orleans Parish. First elected in 2019, Mandie Landry sits on the Health and Welfare, Judiciary, and Ways and Means committees.

paragraphs.text: The House page lists Mandie Landry's occupation as attorney, with a B.A. from the University of Notre Dame (2000) and a J.D. from Georgetown University Law Center (2005).

The House page lists Mandie Landry's committee assignments as Health and Welfare, Judiciary, Ways and Means, Joint Legislative Committee on Capital Outlay, and House Select Committee on Women and Children, and caucus and delegation affiliations as Democratic Caucus, Louisiana Legislative Women's Caucus, and Orleans Delegation.
